name: ableton-live
description: Independent AbletonMCP integration for local Codex clients: typed music tools and a verify-after-edit workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Control Live with a local, typed MCP bridge.
interface.longDescription: Connect local Codex clients to Ableton Live 11/12. Includes setup, read-first editing and offline project analysis guidance. Requires uv and a separately installed Remote Script for live control. Independently maintained; not endorsed by OpenAI or Ableton. Your AI provider may process tool inputs and outputs.
